description: Registry-coverage manifest. When the source file changes in a way that touches the marker, every peer file MUST also change in the same PR. Hard-fail in CI. See docs/architecture/REGISTRY_COVERAGE.md (#2405).

registries.name: DEFAULT_EXPERTS
registries.rationale: Receipts: #2344, #2347 — every entry added requires updating BuiltInExpertTypeSchema, list_experts MCP tool, and the count assertion test.

registries.name: REGISTERED_TOOL_NAMES
registries.rationale: Receipts: #2358 — every new MCP tool requires updating STANDALONE_TOOLS, count tests, annotations, governance script, and SKILL.md PIPELINE NOTE.

registries.name: NEXUS_ENV_VARS
